item.title: visualstudio: Copilot in Visual Studio Just Got a Major Upgrade
item.description:
Copilot Chat in Visual Studio now uses the Microsoft Copilot SDK starting with Visual Studio 2026 version 18.12. It is enabled by default and is described as a major upgrade with broader task coverage using the same models.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: dotnet: Bring Your Own Model to the GitHub Copilot SDK with C#
item.description:
The GitHub Copilot SDK now supports BYOK, allowing apps to keep the agent runtime while routing model requests to a user-managed Microsoft Foundry or Azure OpenAI deployment. The post provides the full C# setup for this configuration.

  • Source: .NET
